verdict.rationale: Abacum's scenario-planning page documents building base, bull and bear versions off the same base and watching revenue, hiring and cash move together when an assumption changes. Scenarios live alongside actuals and forecasts in one workspace, and headcount planning sits in the same model, which supports a hiring-wave scenario. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a side-by-side scenario comparison view, examples of specific scenario types such as a slipped quarter, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
